title: Symmetry of the noise kernel
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $\rho\in[-1,1]$, and let $x,y\in\{-1,1\}^n$. The noise kernel with parameter $\rho$, evaluated at $x$ and $y$, has the same value when the two vectors are interchanged.
